messages:
maya (oncall): Heads up — we're seeing an uptick in 502/504 responses for hosted inference starting ~5m ago. Affects a few customers. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/alert/xyz :rotating_light:

alex (eng-sre): that's around the time the canary rolled. deploy-bot said feature flag `auth_header_trim` was flipped on the new api-router variant.

grafana-bot: alert: HTTP 5xx rate > 4% for /v1/generate across region-us-east for 5m

samir (platform): quick repro: curl to router -> 502
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer longtokenstring...' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< server: proxy
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream closed connection"}
```

maya (oncall): product-support pinged with a sample customer log showing auth parse failures from auth-service: `panic: token header truncated` — looks like header is being truncated by the router when `auth_header_trim` is on.

leo (support): customers reporting failed requests and billing anomalies. I'm consolidating impacted customer ids, ETA for rollback?

alex (eng-sre): immediate mitigation: rollback the flag for canary variant, and scale up the auth-service replicas to absorb retries. Can someone toggle the flag and then we can promote rollback to all router pods? @samir

samir (platform): rolling back flag on canary now.

deploy-bot: flag_update: auth_header_trim disabled on api-router-canary (rev: d4f3) by samir at 4132105830

maya (oncall): after rollback, 5xx rate dropped from 6.8% -> 0.9% over 2m. Seems to be the cause. Good catch.

alex (eng-sre): follow-ups: 1) revert the config change in git and include a test that ensures long auth headers pass through; 2) add a unit test for router's header chunking; 3) schedule a postmortem and customer outreach.

leo (support): I'll open a support ticket bundle and draft customer messaging. Flag customers for potential billing credits.

samir (platform): logging note: we saw router rewriting `Authorization` header by trimming at 128 chars when the flag was on. We'll remove that heuristic and ship a patch that preserves header length. Tracking issue: IS-8731.

maya (oncall): temporary action item assigned to alex/samir. Postmortem owner: maya. I'll update incidents channel when postmortem is posted. :white_check_mark:

alex (eng-sre): creating PR for header handling and adding end-to-end test against real long tokens. Will request review.

leo (support): customers notified; first responses sent. Will follow up with billing next hour.

maya (oncall): closing this incident thread for now — monitoring closely. Thanks team.
